question_english: A widely used psychological tool to measure a teacher's job satisfaction based on Herzberg's theory would focus heavily on measuring:
options_english: Average daily travel duration required to commute to the school campus
Spatial dimensions and seating capacity of faculty staffroom facilities
Monthly frequency of mandatory administrative staff planning meetings
Direct opportunities for achievement and professional recognition
explanation_english: Frederick Herzberg's Dual-Factor (Motivation-Hygiene) Theory distinguishes between hygiene factors and motivators. Hygiene factors (working conditions, commute, staffroom facilities, administrative policies) prevent job dissatisfaction when adequate, but do not produce positive motivation or true job satisfaction. True job satisfaction is generated solely by intrinsic motivator factors—including personal achievement, professional recognition, challenging work, responsibility, and growth opportunities. Therefore, an instrument assessing teachers' job satisfaction based on Herzberg's model must focus heavily on intrinsic motivators such as achievement and recognition. Thus, Option D is correct.
explanation_hindi: फ्रेडरिक हर्ज़बर्ग के द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत (Motivation-Hygiene Theory) के अनुसार कार्यस्थल पर दो भिन्न कारक होते हैं: आरोग्य कारक (Hygiene Factors) जैसे यात्रा समय, भौतिक सुविधाएँ और प्रशासनिक नीतियाँ, जो केवल असंतोष को रोकते हैं किंतु वास्तविक संतुष्टि उत्पन्न नहीं करते। दूसरी ओर, आंतरिक अभिप्रेरक कारक (Motivators) जैसे व्यक्तिगत उपलब्धि, कार्य में सम्मान व पहचान (Recognition), उत्तरदायित्व और पदोन्नति ही कर्मचारियों में वास्तविक कार्य-संतुष्टि और प्रेरणा उत्पन्न करते हैं। अतः हर्ज़बर्ग के सिद्धांत पर आधारित मूल्यांकन उपकरण आंतरिक प्रेरकों (उपलब्धि और सम्मान) पर ध्यान केंद्रित करेगा। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Direct opportunities for achievement and professional recognition.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Based on Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, job satisfaction is driven by intrinsic motivators rather than extrinsic hygiene factors. An assessment tool measuring teacher job satisfaction focuses on intrinsic elements such as direct opportunities for personal achievement, professional recognition, meaningful work responsibility, and career advancement, which foster genuine workplace satisfaction.

question_english: In organizational structure, 'Staff Authority' refers to:
options_english: The authority to hire and fire employees
The authority to advise, assist, and support line managers
The authority to give direct orders down the chain of command
The authority given to non-teaching staff over students
explanation_english: In classical organizational theory, managerial authority is divided into Line Authority and Staff Authority. Line managers possess direct operational authority along the vertical chain of command to issue binding orders and make primary operational decisions. Staff authority, by contrast, is purely advisory, specialized, and supportive. Functional specialists (such as legal advisors, curriculum experts, counselors, and accountants) possess staff authority to investigate problems, provide specialized counsel, and assist line managers in decision-making, but they lack the command authority to issue direct orders to line subordinates. Therefore, Option B accurately defines staff authority.
explanation_hindi: संगठनात्मक सिद्धांतों में अधिकारों को मुख्य रूप से 'लाइन अधिकार' (Line Authority) और 'स्टाफ अधिकार' (Staff Authority) में विभाजित किया जाता है। लाइन अधिकारियों के पास पदसोपानिक श्रृंखला के तहत प्रत्यक्ष आदेश जारी करने और परिचालन संबंधी निर्णय लेने का अधिकार होता है। इसके विपरीत, स्टाफ अधिकार मुख्य रूप से परामर्शी और सहायक प्रकृति (Advisory and Supportive) का होता है। विशेषज्ञ अधिकारी (जैसे विधिक सलाहकार, वित्तीय विशेषज्ञ या अनुसंधानकर्ता) लाइन प्रबंधकों को तकनीकी सलाह, मार्गदर्शन और सहायता प्रदान करते हैं, किंतु उन्हें प्रत्यक्ष आदेश जारी करने की शक्ति नहीं होती। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

question_english: Which of the following is NOT a recognized step in the standard rational decision-making process?
options_english: Systematically defining and identifying the core operational problem
Formulating and generating a broad array of alternative solutions
Selecting alternatives based strictly on alphabetical order
Monitoring and evaluating the final outcomes of implemented decisions
explanation_english: The standard rational decision-making process involves a systematic, objective series of steps: (1) identifying and defining the core problem, (2) gathering relevant information and identifying decision criteria, (3) generating viable alternatives, (4) evaluating alternatives against objective criteria, (5) selecting the optimal alternative, (6) implementing the chosen solution, and (7) monitoring and evaluating outcomes. Choosing alternatives based on an arbitrary, non-substantive criterion such as alphabetical order completely abandons rational analysis and objective problem-solving. Therefore, Option C is not a recognized step.
explanation_hindi: तार्किक निर्णय-प्रक्रिया (Rational Decision-Making Process) एक व्यवस्थित और वस्तुनिष्ठ वैज्ञानिक पद्धति है जिसमें समस्या की पहचान, निर्णय मानदंडों का निर्धारण, वैकल्पिक समाधानों का सृजन, विकल्पों का तार्किक मूल्यांकन, सर्वोत्तम विकल्प का चयन, क्रियान्वयन तथा परिणामों का मूल्यांकन शामिल है। वर्णानुक्रम (Alphabetical order) जैसे मनमाने और अतार्किक आधार पर विकल्पों का चयन करना वस्तुनिष्ठ विश्लेषण और तार्किकता की मूल भावना के सर्वथा विपरीत है। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।

Expanding overall institutional marketing and public relations expenditures
Enforcing strict standardized dress codes for all registered students
Minimizing operational process variations and defect rates
explanation_english: Six Sigma is a disciplined, data-driven methodology designed to improve quality and operational performance by identifying and eliminating defects and minimizing process variation (targeting a near-perfection threshold of no more than 3.4 defects per million opportunities). When applied to educational administration (using the DMAIC framework: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control), it focuses on standardizing administrative and academic processes, eliminating scheduling and record-keeping errors, enhancing workflow predictability, and optimizing service delivery. It does not focus on commercial marketing, aggressive recruitment, or rigid student dress enforcement. Thus, Option D is correct.
explanation_hindi: 'सिक्स सिग्मा' (Six Sigma) एक तथ्य-आधारित एवं व्यवस्थित गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन तकनीक है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य प्रक्रियाओं में होने वाले विचलनों (Variations) को न्यूनतम करना और त्रुटियों (Defects) को समाप्त करना है (अधिकतम 3.4 त्रुटियाँ प्रति दस लाख अवसर)। जब इसे विद्यालय या शैक्षिक प्रबंधन में अनुकूलित किया जाता है, तो यह प्रशासनिक कार्यप्रणाली को मानकीकृत करने, परीक्षा व अभिलेख त्रुटियों को समाप्त करने, समय-सारणी विसंगतियों को दूर करने तथा सेवा प्रदायगी में सुधार लाने पर केंद्रित होता है। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Minimizing operational process variations and defect rates.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Six Sigma is a data-driven quality management methodology aimed at improving process efficiency by identifying and eliminating defects and minimizing operational variations. Adapted to educational administration, it focuses on streamlining administrative workflows, standardizing teaching-learning processes, reducing procedural errors, and continuously improving service delivery across all institutional operations.

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Community participation is an essential component for the effective implementation of the Right to Education Act.
Reason (R): Local communities and parents have a vested interest in the quality of education and can provide critical oversight through the SMC.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are factually true, and Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A). The Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009 intentionally decentralizes school governance by mandating the establishment of School Management Committees (SMCs) under Section 21, in which 75% of members are parents or guardians. Community participation is essential precisely because parents and local community members have an immediate, vested stake in their children's learning outcomes, daily safety, and school environment. Through the SMC, they provide decentralized monitoring and accountability that top-down administrative machinery cannot match. Hence, Option A is the correct answer.
explanation_hindi: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सटीक व्याख्या प्रस्तुत करता है। शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 यह स्वीकार करता है कि केवल नौकरशाही या केंद्रीकृत प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण से प्राथमिक शिक्षा का सार्वभौमीकरण और गुणवत्ता सुनिश्चित नहीं हो सकती; इसके लिए स्थानीय समुदाय की सक्रिय भागीदारी अनिवार्य है (अभिकथन A सही है)। धारा 21 के तहत गठित विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) में 75% सदस्य अभिभावक होते हैं, जिनका अपने बच्चों के भविष्य और विद्यालय की गुणवत्ता से सीधा सरोकार होता है और वे पारदर्शी निगरानी प्रदान करते हैं (कारण R सही है)। यही कारण सामुदायिक सहभागिता को अनिवार्य बनाता है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Community participation is crucial for implementing the Right to Education Act effectively, making the assertion true. The reason is also true and provides a direct explanation: parents and community members have a strong interest in educational quality and exercise critical governance oversight through the School Management Committee, driving accountability.

question_english: The 'Scalar Principle' in an organization dictates that:
options_english: Compensation must strictly follow predetermined formal salary grade structures across all staff tiers
Continuous unbroken line of authority connecting apex leaders to frontline staff
Administrative decision processes must be simplified to their lowest operational components
Supervisory span limits must expand or contract based on total active functional departments
explanation_english: The Scalar Principle (formulated by Henri Fayol as the 'Scalar Chain' and elaborated by Mooney and Reiley) dictates that an organization must possess a continuous, unbroken line of authority and communication running vertically from the highest executive authority to the lowest operational ranks. This vertical chain ensures unambiguous reporting lines, establishes accountability, clarifies the hierarchy of command, and provides an orderly channel through which information and decisions flow. It does not dictate salary grades, operational simplification, or variable spans of control. Therefore, Option B is correct.
explanation_hindi: हेनरी फेयोल द्वारा प्रतिपादित 'पदसोपान का सिद्धांत' (Scalar Principle / Scalar Chain) यह निर्देश देता है कि किसी संगठन में सर्वोच्च प्रशासनिक स्तर से लेकर निम्नतम स्तर के कर्मचारी तक अधिकार, दायित्व और संचार की एक स्पष्ट, सतत और अटूट श्रृंखला होनी चाहिए। इस पदसोपानिक व्यवस्था से यह सुनिश्चित होता है कि प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को यह ज्ञात हो कि उसका वरिष्ठ अधिकारी कौन है, उसे किससे आदेश प्राप्त करने हैं और वह किसके प्रति जवाबदेह है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Continuous unbroken line of authority connecting apex leaders to frontline staff.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Scalar Principle states that an organization must maintain a clear, continuous, and unbroken line of authority extending from top executive leadership down to frontline operational personnel. This scalar chain defines exact reporting relationships, clarifies administrative hierarchy, ensures clear operational communication, and establishes precise accountability across all organizational levels.

question_english: If a school Principal implements a policy of 'Job Rotation' for the administrative staff (e.g., rotating clerks between accounts, admissions, and exam branches), the primary managerial benefit is:
options_english: Significantly lowering total institutional payroll expenses across administrative departments
Mitigating absenteeism disruption by cross-training workers
Elevating routine workplace monotony and psychological fatigue among administrative personnel
Assuring automatic career promotions for all administrative staff members upon completing tenure
explanation_english: Job rotation is a strategic human resource management technique involving the planned, lateral movement of personnel between different functional assignments. In school administration, rotating staff across accounts, admissions, examinations, and records cross-trains employees in multiple roles. The primary managerial benefit is organizational resilience: when a staff member is absent, takes leave, or resigns, other cross-trained employees can seamlessly take over the duties without causing administrative paralysis or workflow disruption. It also relieves routine boredom, but does not reduce overall payroll or guarantee automatic promotions. Thus, Option B is correct.
explanation_hindi: 'कार्य चक्रण' (Job Rotation) एक ऐसी मानव संसाधन प्रबंधकीय रणनीति है जिसमें कर्मचारियों को एक ही विभाग या पटल पर स्थायी रखने के बजाय समय-समय पर विभिन्न प्रशासनिक कार्यों (जैसे लेखा शाखा, परीक्षा शाखा, प्रवेश शाखा आदि) में स्थानांतरित किया जाता है। इसका मुख्य प्रबंधकीय लाभ यह है कि कर्मचारी बहु-कौशल युक्त (Cross-trained) बनते हैं। यदि किसी महत्वपूर्ण शाखा का कर्मचारी अनुपस्थित हो, तो दूसरा कर्मचारी तुरंत उस कार्य को संभाल सकता है, जिससे प्रशासनिक कार्य बाधित नहीं होता। यह कार्य की एकरसता को कम करता है, न कि बढ़ाता है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Mitigating absenteeism disruption by cross-training workers.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Job rotation involves systematically moving administrative staff among different functional roles within the school. The primary managerial benefit of job rotation is cross-training employees in various administrative tasks, which enhances overall operational flexibility, prevents workflow bottlenecks during staff absenteeism, and reduces routine workplace boredom through skill development.

question_english: Which of the following theories of leadership explicitly emphasizes that the leader must act as a 'servant' first, prioritizing the needs of the teachers, students, and community over their own ambition?
options_english: Servant Leadership
Transactional Leadership
Trait Leadership
Charismatic Leadership
explanation_english: Servant Leadership, conceptualized by Robert K. Greenleaf in 1970, posits that effective leadership begins with the natural desire to serve others first ('servant first'). In educational management, a servant leader prioritizes empowering teachers, nurturing students' potential, addressing community needs, and fostering personal and professional growth over exercising top-down executive authority or advancing personal career ambition. Transactional leadership relies on rewards and penalties; trait leadership focuses on innate personality traits; charismatic leadership depends on personal magnetism. Therefore, Option A is correct.
explanation_hindi: 'सेवक नेतृत्व' (Servant Leadership) का सिद्धांत रॉबर्ट के. ग्रीनलीफ द्वारा प्रतिपादित किया गया था। इस सिद्धांत का मूल दर्शन यह है कि एक नेता को सर्वप्रथम दूसरों की सेवा करने की स्वाभाविक इच्छा रखनी चाहिए ('सर्वेंट फर्स्ट')। विद्यालयी संदर्भ में, एक सेवक नेता अपनी व्यक्तिगत सत्ता या महत्वाकांक्षा के स्थान पर शिक्षकों और विद्यार्थियों के सशक्तिकरण, उनके कल्याण और समुदाय के समग्र विकास को सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता देता है। लेन-देन संबंधी नेतृत्व पुरस्कार और दंड पर, विशेषक सिद्धांत जन्मजात गुणों पर तथा करिश्माई नेतृत्व व्यक्तिगत आकर्षण पर आधारित होता है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Servant Leadership

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Servant Leadership, conceptualized by Robert Greenleaf, posits that effective leaders prioritize serving others first. In an educational setting, a servant leader focuses primarily on supporting the needs of teachers, students, and the local community, empowering staff, and fostering personal growth rather than pursuing personal status or executive managerial power.

question_english: The 'PERT' (Program Evaluation and Review Technique) chart is a tool used in educational management primarily for:
options_english: Financial auditing
Conducting psychological assessments of students
Project planning and scheduling complex tasks
Managing the daily attendance of teachers
explanation_english: The Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT) is a network-based statistical project management tool designed to analyze, schedule, coordinate, and control complex, non-repetitive projects. By graphically displaying task sequences, event milestones, activity dependencies, and probabilistic time estimates (optimistic, most likely, and pessimistic), PERT charts help educational administrators identify the Critical Path—the sequence of dependent tasks that determines the minimum total project duration. In schools, PERT is used for planning complex institutional initiatives such as sports meets, infrastructure expansion, and accreditation drives. Hence, Option C is correct.
explanation_hindi: 'कार्यक्रम मूल्यांकन एवं समीक्षा तकनीक' (PERT - Program Evaluation and Review Technique) एक सुप्रसिद्ध परियोजना प्रबंधन उपकरण है। इसका उपयोग जटिल और परस्पर निर्भर गतिविधियों वाली परियोजनाओं के नियोजन, समय-सारणीकरण (Scheduling) और नियंत्रण के लिए किया जाता है। PERT आरेख विभिन्न गतिविधियों के आपसी संबंधों को नेटवर्क के रूप में दर्शाता है और 'क्रांतिक पथ' (Critical Path) की पहचान करके यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि परियोजना न्यूनतम समय और संसाधनों में पूरी हो सके। शैक्षिक प्रबंधन में इसका उपयोग वार्षिक उत्सव, निर्माण कार्य या बड़े आयोजनों के नियोजन हेतु किया जाता है। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Project planning and scheduling complex tasks

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT) is a statistical project management tool used to analyze, plan, and schedule complex tasks within a project. In educational management, PERT charts help administrators map task dependencies, estimate realistic completion timelines, manage critical paths, and coordinate complex institutional projects efficiently.

question_hindi:
एक नवनियुक्त प्रधानाचार्य देखते हैं कि विद्यालय की संस्कृति अत्यंत विषाक्त है; शिक्षक संसाधन साझा नहीं करते, विद्यार्थियों की निरंतर शिकायत करते हैं और किसी भी नई शिक्षण पहल का विरोध करते हैं। यह समझकर कि केवल संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन काम नहीं करेंगे, प्रधानाचार्य तीन वर्षों में संस्कृति को बदलने हेतु 'अंगीकृत मूल्यों' (Espoused Values) और 'मूलभूत मान्यताओं' (Basic Assumptions) पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने का निर्णय लेते हैं।

question_english:
A newly joined Principal observes that the school culture is highly toxic; teachers do not share resources, complain endlessly about students, and resist any new pedagogical initiatives. Realizing that structural changes alone will not work, the Principal decides to focus on 'Espoused Values' and 'Basic Assumptions' to shift the culture over three years.
Whose model of organizational culture is the Principal utilizing?
options_english: Kurt Lewin
Henri Fayol
Douglas McGregor
Edgar Schein
explanation_english: Edgar Schein formulated the definitive three-level model of organizational culture: (1) Artifacts (visible surface structures and behaviors), (2) Espoused Values (conscious strategies, stated philosophies, and goals articulated by leadership), and (3) Basic Underlying Assumptions (unconscious, deeply ingrained beliefs, habits of perception, and premises that form the true essence of culture). By recognizing that superficial administrative changes will fail without transforming shared values and unconscious assumptions, the Principal is directly applying Edgar Schein's theoretical model. Lewin formulated 3-step change, Fayol created 14 management principles, and McGregor developed Theory X and Y. Therefore, Option D is correct.
explanation_hindi: एमआईटी के प्रख्यात संगठनात्मक मनोवैज्ञानिक एडगर शाइन (Edgar Schein) ने संगठनात्मक संस्कृति का त्रि-स्तरीय मॉडल प्रतिपादित किया था: 1. दृश्यमान प्रतीक व कलाकृतियाँ (Artifacts - सतही स्तर), 2. अंगीकृत मूल्य (Espoused Values - घोषित रणनीतियाँ, दर्शन और नियम), तथा 3. मूलभूत अंतर्निहित मान्यताएँ (Basic Underlying Assumptions - अचेतन, स्वतः सिद्ध और गहराई से जमी हुई मान्यताएँ जो वास्तविक व्यवहार को निर्धारित करती हैं)। विद्यालय के नकारात्मक माहौल को बदलने के लिए अंगीकृत मूल्यों और अंतर्निहित मान्यताओं को लक्षित करना सीधे तौर पर एडगर शाइन के सांस्कृतिक मॉडल का अनुप्रयोग है। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Edgar Schein

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Edgar Schein developed the three-level model of organizational culture comprising Artifacts, Espoused Values, and Basic Underlying Assumptions. By focusing on changing shared values and deeply rooted underlying assumptions to transform a toxic school environment, the principal is directly applying Schein’s theoretical framework to achieve long-term cultural transformation.

question_english: In the context of school management, the 'Principle of Division of Work' aims to achieve:
options_english: Minimizing overall staff retention rates
Centralizing all executive authority
Specialization and efficiency
Disrupting scalar chains of command
explanation_english: Henri Fayol's first principle of administrative management, the 'Principle of Division of Work', posits that dividing complex institutional labor into discrete, specialized tasks and assigning them to individuals based on specific competencies and expertise produces specialization and efficiency. In school management, allocating distinct teaching subjects, grade bands, laboratory responsibilities, and administrative duties (like examinations, admissions, and library management) to specialized staff allows teachers and administrators to hone specialized skills, reduces effort and time waste, and elevates overall institutional productivity. Hence, Option C is correct.
explanation_hindi: हेनरी फेयोल के प्रबंधन के सिद्धांतों में 'कार्य-विभाजन का सिद्धांत' (Division of Work) प्रथम सिद्धांत है। इसके अनुसार, संस्थान के कार्यों को छोटे-छोटे विशिष्ट कार्यों में विभाजित कर कर्मचारियों को उनकी योग्यता और विशेषज्ञता के अनुसार कार्य सौंपा जाना चाहिए। विद्यालय प्रबंधन में जब शिक्षकों को उनकी विषय विशेषज्ञता (जैसे गणित, विज्ञान, सामाजिक अध्ययन) और प्रशासनिक कर्मचारियों को विशिष्ट पटल सौंपे जाते हैं, तो इससे कार्यकुशलता, विशिष्टता (विशेषज्ञता) और परिचालन दक्षता में वृद्धि होती है। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Specialization and efficiency

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Henri Fayol’s principle of Division of Work dictates that tasks should be divided into specialized components and assigned to personnel based on specific skills. In school management, dividing work allows teachers and staff to focus on specialized areas of expertise, improving operational efficiency, instructional quality, and overall administrative productivity.

question_english: Which document serves as the supreme rulebook governing the service conditions, code of conduct, and disciplinary proceedings for employees in recognized schools in Delhi?
options_english: Central Civil Services (CCS) Conduct and Leave Rules Regulations
Delhi School Education Act and Rules (DSEAR), 1973
Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act Regulations
Framework Guidelines of the National Education Policy Standards
explanation_english: The Delhi School Education Act and Rules (DSEAR), 1973 is the paramount statutory legislation enacted by Parliament governing recognized public, government-aided, and private unaided schools in Delhi. Chapters IV and V of the Act, along with Rules 115 through 123, lay down comprehensive statutory provisions regulating terms and conditions of service, recruitment qualifications, minimum salary parity (Section 10), code of conduct, penalties, suspension rules, disciplinary inquiry procedures, and appellate jurisdiction under the Delhi School Teachers Tribunal. While CCS rules provide supplementary guidance for government staff where DSEAR is silent, DSEAR 1973 remains the supreme governing rulebook for all recognized schools in Delhi. Thus, Option B is correct.
explanation_hindi: संसद द्वारा अधिनियमित 'दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षा अधिनियम और नियम' (DSEAR), 1973 दिल्ली के सभी मान्यता प्राप्त (सरकारी, सहायता प्राप्त और गैर-सहायता प्राप्त निजी) विद्यालयों के संचालन हेतु सर्वोच्च वैधानिक नियम-पुस्तिका है। इसके नियम 115 से 123 तक कर्मचारियों की सेवा शर्तें, भर्ती नियम, धारा 10 के तहत सरकारी कर्मचारियों के समान वेतनमान की अनिवार्यता, आचार संहिता, निलंबन, जाँच प्रक्रियाएँ और दिल्ली स्कूल शिक्षक अधिकरण (DSTT) में अपील के प्रावधान दिए गए हैं। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Delhi School Education Act and Rules (DSEAR), 1973

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Delhi School Education Act and Rules, 1973, serves as the primary statutory legislation governing recognized private and public schools in Delhi. It outlines comprehensive legal provisions regulating school administration, employee service conditions, recruitment guidelines, code of conduct, disciplinary procedures, and financial management across educational institutions.

question_hindi: एक प्रधानाचार्य वार्षिक खेल दिवस के आयोजन का दायित्व शारीरिक शिक्षा शिक्षक (PET) को प्रत्यायोजित करते हैं, परंतु बजट पर अंतिम निर्णय का अधिकार अपने पास रखते हैं। यह दर्शाता है कि प्रत्यायोजन (Delegation) में:

अधिकार साझा या प्रत्यायोजित किया जाता है, परंतु प्रत्यायोजनकर्ता अंतिम जवाबदेही अपने पास रखता है

question_english: A principal delegates the task of organizing the annual sports day to a Physical Education Teacher (PET) but retains the final say on the budget. This demonstrates that in delegation:
options_english: Managerial accountability gets transferred entirely to the designated subordinate staff member
Personal responsibility for outcomes gets eliminated completely upon formal delegation
Task delegation signifies an inherent structural failure in administrative leadership capacity
Authority is shared, but the delegator retains ultimate accountability
explanation_english: Delegation of authority is an essential administrative process comprising three interconnected elements: assignment of responsibility, granting of authority, and creation of accountability. A fundamental tenet of management theory is that while operational authority can be delegated to subordinates to execute tasks, ultimate managerial accountability cannot be abdicated or transferred. The Principal grants the PET necessary operational authority to plan and coordinate sports day events, but the Principal retains final budgetary control and remains ultimately accountable to the school management, educational authorities, and parents for the event's overall success, safety, and fiscal propriety. Therefore, Option D is correct.
explanation_hindi: प्रशासनिक प्रबंधन का एक सर्वमान्य सिद्धांत यह है कि 'अधिकारों का प्रत्यायोजन तो किया जा सकता है, किंतु अंतिम जवाबदेही का प्रत्यायोजन नहीं हो सकता' (Accountability cannot be delegated)। जब प्रधानाचार्य खेल शिक्षक को खेल दिवस आयोजित करने का अधिकार देते हैं, तो शिक्षक कार्य-संपादन के लिए जिम्मेदार होता है, परंतु यदि वित्तीय अनियमितता या कोई विफलता होती है, तो उच्चाधिकारियों और एसएमसी के प्रति अंतिम रूप से जवाबदेह प्रधानाचार्य ही रहेंगे। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Authority is shared, but the delegator retains ultimate accountability.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Delegation of authority allows a manager to assign specific operational tasks and grant decision-making powers to subordinates. However, delegation does not transfer absolute responsibility; the principal retains ultimate accountability for overall performance outcomes and financial management, demonstrating that authority can be shared while executive accountability remains with leadership.

question_english: The term 'Synergy' in organizational behavior and school management means:
options_english: Combined group effort yielding outputs exceeding separate inputs
Total psychological energy expended by professional personnel operating in complete isolation
Structured conflict resolution methodologies designed to eliminate divergent personal viewpoints
Technical administrative procedures for synchronizing classroom physical timekeeping devices
explanation_english: In systems theory and organizational behavior, 'Synergy' refers to the phenomenon where the collective performance and output of individuals working together collaboratively exceeds the sum of their individual outputs produced in isolation (symbolized as 2 + 2 = 5). In school management, synergistic teamwork among subject teachers, special educators, student counselors, and administrative staff creates innovative multidisciplinary pedagogical practices and operational efficiencies that single educators operating independently could never achieve alone. Hence, Option A accurately defines synergy.
explanation_hindi: प्रणाली सिद्धांत (Systems Theory) और संगठनात्मक व्यवहार में 'सहक्रियाशीलता' (Synergy - सिनर्जी) उस स्थिति को संदर्भित करती है जहाँ मिलकर कार्य करने वाली एक पूरी टीम या संगठन का कुल परिणाम उसके सभी सदस्यों के अलग-अलग व एकाकी प्रयासों के कुल योग से कहीं अधिक होता है (2 + 2 = 5)। विद्यालय प्रबंधन में जब विभिन्न विषयों के शिक्षक, परामर्शदाता और प्रशासक एक साझा दृष्टि के साथ मिलकर टीम भावना से कार्य करते हैं, तो शिक्षण की गुणवत्ता और विद्यार्थियों का सर्वांगीण विकास एकाकी प्रयासों की तुलना में अत्यधिक श्रेष्ठ होता है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Combined group effort yielding outputs exceeding separate inputs.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Synergy in organizational behavior refers to the concept that the combined performance and output of a group working collaboratively exceeds the sum of individual contributions operating independently. In school management, establishing synergistic teamwork across departments enhances creative problem-solving, operational efficiency, and overall educational quality beyond separate individual efforts.

question_hindi:

I. यह विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) को सम्मिलित करते हुए एक सहभागी प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से तैयार की जाती है।

question_english:
Consider the following hallmarks of an effective 'School Development Plan' (SDP):
I. It is prepared through a participatory process involving the SMC.
II. It includes estimates for class-wise enrollment for the next three years.
III. It details the requirement of additional infrastructure and equipment.
IV. It is finalized exclusively by the Zonal Education Officer without school input.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II, and III only
I, II, and IV only
II, III, and IV only
I, III, and IV only
explanation_english: Under Section 22 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 and institutional planning frameworks, a School Development Plan (SDP) is formulated through a participatory, bottom-up process by the School Management Committee (Statement I is correct). Under statutory guidelines, the SDP is a three-year rolling plan containing class-wise enrollment projections for the subsequent three academic years (Statement II is correct). It comprehensively outlines requirements for additional classrooms, barrier-free access, learning aids, toilets, and equipment to satisfy schedule norms (Statement III is correct). Statement IV is false because unilaterally finalizing the plan by an external Zonal Education Officer without school/SMC consultation contravenes the decentralized legislative architecture of the RTE Act. Thus, statements I, II, and III only are correct (Option A).
explanation_hindi: शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 22 के अनुसार, विद्यालय विकास योजना (SDP) विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) द्वारा शिक्षकों व अभिभावकों की सक्रिय व सहभागी प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से तैयार की जाती है (कथन I सही है)। यह योजना आगामी तीन वर्षों के लिए कक्षा-वार छात्र नामांकन के अनुमान प्रस्तुत करती है (कथन II सही है)। इसमें अतिरिक्त कक्षाओं, उपस्करों, शौचालयों और शिक्षण अधिगम सामग्री (TLM) की आवश्यकता का विस्तृत ब्योरा होता है (कथन III सही है)। कथन IV गलत है क्योंकि जोनल शिक्षा अधिकारी द्वारा विद्यालय के परामर्श के बिना इसे एकतरफा अंतिम रूप देना विकेंद्रीकृत संस्थागत नियोजन और विधिक प्रावधानों का उल्लंघन है। अतः केवल कथन I, II और III सही हैं (विकल्प A)।
topic: Management: Nature, Scope, and Five Functions
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II, and III only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A School Development Plan is a participatory plan formulated by the SMC, featuring multi-year student enrollment projections and detailed assessments of additional infrastructure and resource requirements. Statement IV is incorrect because finalizing the plan exclusively by a Zonal Education Officer violates the statutory decentralized, school-based planning framework.
